name: Expedite Rejection Due to Infeasible Delivery Date
description: Tests that open Purchase Orders whose expedited transit cannot arrive before the shortage date are strictly excluded from recommendation.

expectedBehavior.rejectionReason: Calculated expedited arrival date 2026-11-14 is strictly after shortage date 2026-11-12.
expectedBehavior.details: Engine refuses to generate false-positive expedite recommendation for orders that would arrive late.
